name: off
text: ずっと、なんてないのかも
trans: There might be no such thing as 'forever'.

name: off
text: 絶対、というのもないのかも

name: off
trans: Even so, we want to say this.

name: off
text: ずっとイルミネーションスターズでいよう

name: 真乃
text: ……空が、とってもきれいだから……
trans: ...The sky is really clear today, so...

name: 真乃
text:
この間教えてもらった影送り、
やってみようかなって……
trans:
I want to try doing the 'shadow projecting'
you told me about back then...

name: 真乃
trans: But... I can't really project my shadow up in the sky...

name: めぐる
text:
あんまり力まないで、
ゆーっくり５つ数えると成功しやすいよ
trans:
Don't strain yourself too much, and try counting to 
five slowly as you stare at your shadow. It should be 
easier that way!

name: 真乃
text:
わ……
ありがとう、めぐるちゃん……っ

name: めぐる
text:
見えたー？
なんか不思議だよねぇ……
trans:
Did you see your shadow up there?
It's kinda weird, right...?

name: 灯織
text:
私もやってみようかな
めぐるもどう？
trans:
Maybe I should try doing it too.
How about you, Meguru?

name: めぐる
text: そこまでではないんだけど……！

name: めぐる
text: なんか、ちょっと寂しい気持ちになっちゃうっていうか
trans: It makes me feel... kinda lonely, somehow.

name: めぐる
text: なんでかなぁ？　って思ってたんだけどね
trans: I was wondering why I feel like that for a bit, but...

name: めぐる
text:
たぶん、一緒にいるのに
同じものが見えないからなんだと思う
trans:
I think it's because we can't see the same thing even 
though we're here together like this.

name: めぐる
text:
真乃が送った影、真乃には見えてるのに
わたしには見えないのが寂しくなっちゃうんだなーって
trans:
Mano can see the shadow she sends up there,
but I can't, so... it makes me feel kinda lonely.

name: めぐる
text:
──……ごめん！　変なこと言っちゃった！
あはは……
trans:
──......Sorry! I said something weird there!
Ahaha......

name: 真乃
text: 灯織ちゃんも……いいかな……？

name: 真乃
text:
こうして、３人で手をつないで、
同じ影を送ってみるのはどうかな……
trans:
What if we stand while holding our hands together 
like this, and then look at the same shadow and 
project it up there...?

name: 真乃
text:
……そうしたら、見えたらいいなって……
同じものが……
trans:
That way, I think we'd all be able to see the same 
thing... It'd be nice if we really can...

name: めぐる
text:
そうだったー！
一緒にやれば同じ影を送れるよね……！
trans:
So that's how it iis!
If we do it together, we should be able to project the 
same shadow, right...!

name: 灯織
text:
３人で手を繋いだ影なのもいいね
いつものあれみたいで
trans:
The shadow of us holding hands together would 
be nice to see. Just like how we usually do it.

name: めぐる
trans: ──Then, we look up at the sky...!

name: めぐる
trans: Did you two see it too!?

name: 真乃
text:
……わ、私も、見えたよっ
３人の影がならんでた……っ
trans:
...I-I see it too...!
The three of us are projected up there...

name: 灯織
text:
すぐに消えちゃうのが、
少し物悲しい気持ちになるけど……
trans:
Though it makes me kinda sad that it disappears
immediately...

name: めぐる
text:
うん……
でも、思い出はずっと残るよ
trans:
Yeah...
But, our memories will still remain forever!

name: めぐる
trans: I won't ever forget about this!

name: めぐる
trans:
That's why, we're going to be together. 
Forever────!
